core.title: Radiance Clear Acrylic Cabinet Pull, RK International CP-470

text.description_html:
RK International CP-470, Acrylic Radiance Cabinet Handle

The Radiance Clear Acrylic Cabinet Pull has a transitional feel that successfully straddles the line between modern and traditional. This beautiful kitchen cabinet hardware will add style to your remodel while still giving off the sense of family and warmth. The Acrylic Radiance Cabinet Handle is available in 4 sizes: 4 inch, 6 inch, 8 inch and 10 inch. While the clear acrylic is so high quality it almost disappears, the stylish mounts are available in several of the most popular finish choices in the design world.

Also Available Matching Small Radiance Cabinet Knob, Large Radiance Cabinet Knob, and Radiance Appliance Pull, 12 Inch Radiance Appliance Pull, and 18 Inch Radiance Appliance Pull

Features of the Radiance Pulls:

  • Handle Material: Clear Acrylic
  • Bracket Material: Solid Brass
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.
  • Adjustable center to centers.

Available in 4 Sizes:

    RKI-CP-470:
    • Length c.c. (center to center): 4"
    • Overall Length: 6"
    • Diameter: 1/2"
    • Projection: 1-7/16"

    RKI-CP-471:
    • Length c.c. (center to center): 6"
    • Overall Length: 8"
    • Diameter: 1/2"
    • Projection: 1-7/16"

    RKI-CP-472:
    • Length c.c. (center to center): 8"
    • Overall Length: 10"
    • Diameter: 1/2"
    • Projection: 1-7/16"

    RKI-CP-473:
    • Length c.c. (center to center): 10"
    • Overall Length: 12"
    • Diameter: 1/2"
    • Projection: 1-7/16"

Sold Individually
